title: Budgeting VRAM before you press Queue
hook: Read a file's parameter count from its header without loading it, add up the parts, and know before you queue whether a graph will fit.

verified.claim: The safetensors layout is an 8-byte little-endian length, a JSON header, and raw data, so a header can be read without the data.
The lab builds such a file in memory and counts parameters from the header.
The 10% margin in step 5 and the reserve come from load_models_gpu. The worksheet is a simpler sum of our own, without the margin.
A text encoder does not need to stay on the card while the sampler runs: models are unloaded when room is needed.

unchecked: Every size in the worksheet is an example, not a measurement of any model.
Your own peak depends on model code and card. This is a planning estimate, and only a run tells you for sure. We make no claim about how close it comes for any graph.
